items.text: I’m flying from MAN toORD on Sunday and wanted to know if blankets are supplied on your flights especially for our overnight return? Also I booked through BA but is your flight will I get a carry on allowance?

cases.q: do you guys offer blankets during overnight flights or should I purchase in advance? Just a cold lil' gal over here. Thanks!
cases.reply: We offer blankets and pillows in First and Business Class! You're always welcome to bring along your most favorite cozy blanket with you.

cases.reply: We're sorry to let you down, Lisa. Blankets and pillow packs are not available on every flight destination.

cases.q: with basic economy, i know i can bring a personal item but can i bring a blanket too??? does that count as a carry-on???
cases.reply: Your blanket needs to fit in your carry-on. But you can take it out on the plane.

cases.q: AA1379 LAX-->BOS. FAs say AA doesn't provide blankets on this route. For an overnight flight. Really? +plane is hot. No air. 👎🏽
cases.reply: We always want you to be comfortable and our apologies you're not.

cases.q: . no blankets for coach? Your flight temps are too low. Where has basic customer service gone? #sad
cases.reply: We're not always able to provide blankets on board for all of our customers. You're always to bring your own on board.
